$comment: Hand-sourced coordinates for names `npm run harvest:coords` cannot place on its own, merged over its OpenStreetMap result so a re-run never loses them. Every entry carries where its coordinate came from — nothing here is a guess at a location. `unplaceable` names the entries that have no defensible point at all; they get no lamp, and lib/geography.test.ts checks this file against data/places.json so the gap stays declared instead of silent.

placed.name: Alevkayası
placed.note: OSM tags it place=locality rather than a settlement, so the harvest's place filter never sees it.

placed.name: Boğaz
placed.note: The Beşparmak pass — places.json files this under Girne and spells the alias 'Boğaz Girne'. OSM's only place=village named Boğaz is İskele's, 27km east, which the harvest would otherwise pick.

placed.name: Bostancı
placed.note: OSM carries the village as a landuse=residential area, with no place node on it.

placed.name: Değirmenlik Yolu
placed.note: A road, not a settlement, but announcements name it on its own. The point is the midpoint of the two ends the road is named for, Lefkoşa and Değirmenlik.

placed.name: Ercan
placed.note: The airport. OSM: aeroway=aerodrome 'Ercan Uluslararası Havalimanı'. Announcements mean the airport and the works around it, not a village.

placed.name: Erülkü Süpermarket
placed.note: Not a settlement, but announcements locate outages by it — KIB-TEK published one whose only location was 'Erülkü Süpermarket çevresi', which three outlets carried and the ingest dropped. OSM has the building as shop=supermarket, which the harvest's place query cannot see. District confirmed by the maintainer; asking a model for it produced a confident wrong answer twice over.

placed.name: Kombos
placed.note: A quarter of Gazimağusa. OSM has it only as the square, 'Kombos Meydanı'.

placed.name: Lapta Yolu
placed.note: A road, not a settlement. The point is the midpoint of the coast road's two ends, Girne and Lapta.

unplaceable.name: Ayluga
unplaceable.note: A Gazimağusa quarter. Neither OSM nor Nominatim knows the name under any spelling. Measured against 82 real archived records: it appears twice, and both times alongside places that do have lamps — so no outage has yet been invisible because of it.

unplaceable.name: Karakeşliler
unplaceable.note: Same: no OSM or Nominatim record under any of the spellings places.json carries. Also appears twice in those 82 records, never on its own.
